summary: Meta announces that a model's weights are now available on Hugging Face, deployable through several serving frameworks, after clearing an internal safety review for open-weight release.

mechanisms.reason: The weights are stated to run through edge/on-device serving stacks (MLX, executorch, llama.cpp) alongside datacenter-oriented ones.

practices.reason: Weights are now downloadable, enabling self-hosting or fine-tuning by any engineering team.
The model is immediately runnable across a named set of serving frameworks and hosts, which determines what integration work is needed to deploy it.
practices.quote: running this week through ollama, LM Studio, vllm, sglang, together, fireworks, and openrouter

practices.reason: The release references an internal safety scaling framework used to clear the model, but no methodology is disclosed for external replication.
practices.quote: evaluated under meta's advanced AI scaling framework and cleared for open-weight release.
